source_snapshot.title: UAE's Khor Fakkan municipality announces relocation of boats from three berths
source_snapshot.text: UAE's Khor Fakkan Municipality announced the evacuation of the first three berths from the boat landing side of Khor Fakkan Marina, and their relocation to Al Lulu'iyah Marina. All owners of marine vessels and users of the berths were asked to vacate them and move their boats by October 28. The municipality said that after the deadline, necessary measures would be taken, and those who fail to comply would face consequences.

claims.claim: In Khor Fakkan, boats are being relocated from three berths.
The Khor Fakkan Municipality announced the evacuation of boats from the first three berths on the boat landing side of Khor Fakkan Marina.
Boat owners must move their boats to Al Lulu'iyah Marina by October 28.
After October 28, the municipality will take measures against those who do not comply.

summary_ru: 🚤 В Хор-Факкане перемещают лодки с трёх причалов 📅 Муниципалитет Хор-Факкана объявил о необходимости эвакуации лодок с первых трёх причалов на стороне лодочной пристани марины Хор-Факкан. Владельцы судов должны перевезти свои лодки в марину Аль Лулу'ия до 28 октября. После этой даты муниципалитет примет меры в отношении тех, кто не выполнит требование.
